metadata.scenario: A confused new client questions a surcharge on their invoice, believing it to be an error. Category: Billing. Flags: billing_dispute.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret speaking. How can I assist you today? Hi Margaret, this is Patricia Wilson. I’m calling about a billing issue I noticed on my mother’s invoice. Oh, I’m sorry to hear that, Patricia. Can you tell me what the issue is? There’s a surcharge on the invoice that I don’t understand. I think it might be an error. I can help with that. Can you provide me with the invoice number? Yes, it’s 24567. It’s for her post-surgery care after her hip replacement. Thank you, Patricia. Let me pull that up for you. One moment please. Sure, take your time. I see the invoice here. The surcharge you’re referring to is the additional charge for extended care hours. Extended care hours? I wasn’t aware of that. I thought it was just the standard rate. I understand, Patricia. The extended care charge applies when care exceeds the hours initially scheduled. But my mother didn’t need that much extra care. Can you confirm how many hours were provided? Yes, let me check that… It looks like she received four hours of care instead of the two that were scheduled. That doesn’t sound right. I need to speak with someone about this. I completely understand. I can connect you with our Client Services Manager, Angela Martinez. Yes, please. I need clarification on this. I’ll set that up for you. Angela’s available at +13165559202. I’ll inform her of your concern. Thank you. But what if I want to dispute the charge? We can initiate a review process for you. I’ll take note of that and keep you updated. That would be great. I just want to make sure I’m not overpaying. Absolutely. I’ll follow up with you after the review is complete. Would you prefer a call or an email? An email would be best, please. Got it, I'll send you an email with the details. Is there anything else I can help you with today? Actually, I wanted to ask about scheduling additional post-surgery care. Sure! We offer post-surgery recovery care at $85 to $110 per session. That sounds reasonable. Can we discuss scheduling that as well? Of course! I’ll connect you with Lisa Chen, our Care Coordinator. Thank you, Margaret. I appreciate your help. You’re welcome, Patricia. I’ll be in touch regarding the billing issue soon. Sounds good, I’ll wait for your email. Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health. Have a great day! You too, bye!
